page_title: DOR 5-1 AUG | Dortmund v Augsburg 04/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' Tomas Koubek leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Julian Brandt (Dortmund).
90' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
86' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post.
85' Dortmund take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

84' Chance! Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
79' The linesman points to the corner flag, Augsburg are going to take it.
79' Mert Komur (Augsburg) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
78' Arne Engels (Augsburg) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Tim Breithaupt.
77' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) works the corner short.

76' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score in the left side of the goal, but great anticipation by Tomas Koubek allowed him to make a comfortable save.
75' The total number of attempts is 15:16.
74' It will be a substitution. Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) is ready to enter the pitch as Felix Nmecha walks off.
73' Here is a change. Arne Maier is going off and Jess Thorup gives the last tactical orders to Mert Komur (Augsburg).
70' A shot from the edge of the box by Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) is a waste and goes well wide of the right post.
68' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Dortmund comes to nothing.
67' Here comes a substitution. Patric Pfeiffer (Augsburg) is brought on as a substitute for Maximilian Bauer.
67' That will be all from Phillip Tietz who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Dion Beljo (Augsburg).
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ruben Vargas trots off the pitch and is replaced by Niklas Dorsch (Augsburg).
67' Edin Terzic has decided to make a change. Julian Brandt (Dortmund) replaces Marco Reus.

65' Marco Reus (Dortmund) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Tomas Koubek anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going low into the middle of the target.
64' 5 - 1 Goal - 5:1! Marco Reus laid the ball off to Felix Nmecha (Dortmund), who shot from close range into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
63' Substitution. Salih Ozcan (Dortmund) on for Marius Wolf.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) comes onto the pitch for Donyell Malen.
63' Edin Terzic has decided to substitute Mateu Morey Bauza and he is replaced by Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund).
62' The ball is out of play. Augsburg will have a chance to score from a corner.
61' A header by Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) from very close range goes towards the crossbar, but doesn't get past Gregor Kobel, who makes a brilliant save.
61' Augsburg have been awarded a corner kick.
60' Augsburg work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
58' Good work from Augsburg as they win a corner.
58' Arne Maier (Augsburg) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
55' The linesman makes the right call and Dortmund will have a corner.
52' What a huge chance for Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
49' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes way over the bar.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.

43' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands.
38' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
34' 4 - 1 GOAL! Marco Reus (Dortmund) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Tomas Koubek, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 4:1.
32' 3 - 1 Goal! Arne Maier plays it to Ruben Vargas (Augsburg), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Gregor Kobel. 3:1.
32' Arne Maier (Augsburg) is about to take a corner kick.
29' 3 - 0 It’s a GOAL! Youssoufa Moukoko (Dortmund) gets on the end of the corner and bundles the ball into the net with his body.
29' There's an opportunity for Marco Reus (Dortmund) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

29' What a wasted opportunity by Donyell Malen (Dortmund)! He creates himself some space inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the left side of the goal, but Tomas Koubek makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
27' Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
25' Arne Maier (Augsburg) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
23' The resulting corner from Arne Maier (Augsburg) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

20' 2 - 0 It's a goal! Donyell Malen (Dortmund) makes it 2:0. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Jamie Bynoe-Gittens and planted his close-range header into the bottom right corner. Tomas Koubek was helpless.
19' Augsburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
19' Arne Maier (Augsburg) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him.
17' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the right post.
16' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) controls a reverse pass deep inside the box and smacks the ball low towards the middle of the goal, but the Tomas Koubek anticipates well and smothers the ball.
13' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
10' Robert Schroder shows a yellow card to Maximilian Bauer (Augsburg) for his blatant foul.
9' Marco Reus (Dortmund) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
9' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund).
7' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) commits a foul and Robert Schroder immediately signals a free kick.
4' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0. Youssoufa Moukoko (Dortmund) is first to the rebound and finds the back of the net with a brilliant back-heel finish.
2' Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Gregor Kobel intercepts the ball.
